title: CSKA Sweep UNICS in Kazan to Seize a 13th VTB League Crown
description: CSKA Moscow finished the job in style, beating UNICS Kazan 102-76 on the road in Game 4 of the VTB United League finals to complete a clean 4-0 sweep and claim the championship. UNICS, facing elimination at 0-3, came out with the urgency the situation demanded and built an early 10-point lead, their aggressive defense producing five blocks in the opening quarter. But that physicality came at a cost: CSKA went a perfect 11-of-11 from the foul line and surged ahead in the second quarter. Despite shooting just 40.5 percent from the field to the hosts' 66.7 in the first half, the visitors leaned on a huge edge in shot volume (37-24), offensive rebounds (9-3) and forced turnovers to take a one-point lead into the break.
imageCaption: CSKA Sweep UNICS in Kazan to Seize a 13th VTB League Crown (Photo: VTB United League)

title: CSKA beat Zenit to defend the title
description: CSKA - Zenit 96-73 CSKA repeated as the VTB League champions. They outscored Zenit in Game 6 of the Finals to defend the trophy. Melo Trimble (190-G-1995, college: Maryland, agency: Pensack Sports) posted 20 points to pace the Moscow team. He was named the MVP. CSKA unloaded 29 points in the second period to gain a 52-39 halftime lead. CSKA followed with a strong 26-15 rally in the third period to secure a comfortable 24-point lead at the final intermission. Zenit slowed the hosts down in the fourth term but could not avoid the loss. Amath M'Baye (205-PF-1989, college: Oklahoma) produced 19 points for the champions. Trent Frazier (188-G-1998, college: Illinois) answered with 17 points, while Dwayne Bacon (201-SF-1995, college: FSU) had 16 points for Zenit.
imageCaption: CSKA beat Zenit to defend the title (Photo: vtb-league.com)

title: Round 5 of Finals. CSKA upset UNICS to capture the trophy
description: UNICS - CSKA 55-66 CSKA conquered VTB League title. They upset UNICS in Kazan to lift the trophy. The guests trailed by 4 points at the halftime before their 32-17 charge in the second half, which allowed them to win the game. Nigerian center Tonye Jekiri (212-1994, college: Miami, FL) orchestrated the victory by scoring 11 points and 9 rebounds. Belarusian forward Anton Astapkovich (202-1994) contributed with 12 points and 5 rebounds for the winners. Melo Trimble finished with 10 points and was named the Finals MVP. American center Jalen Reynolds (208-1992, college: Xavier) answered with 18 points and 8 rebounds and the other American import guard Marcos Knight (191-1989, college: MTSU, agency: Slash Sports) added 8 points, 5 rebounds and 5 assists in the effort for UNICS.
imageCaption: CSKA upset UNICS to capture the trophy (Photo: vtb-league.com)

title: Unics crowned 22/23 champions
description: UNICS made 28-of-31 charity shots (90.3 percent) during the game. Lokomotiv was plagued by 28 personal fouls down the stretch. North Macedonian point guard Nenad Dimitrijevic (190-1998) orchestrated the victory by scoring 34 points (!!!) and 5 rebounds. American guard Marcos Knight (191-1989, college: MTSU, agency: Slash Sports) contributed with 16 points, 5 rebounds and 5 assists for the winners. American guard Jaylen Barford (191-1996, college: Arkansas) answered with 22 points and 6 assists and the other American import forward Okaro White (206-1992, college: FSU) added 21 points in the effort for Lokomotiv. Both teams had four players each who scored in double figures. Lokomotiv's coach rotated twelve players in this game, but that didn't help.
imageCaption: UNICS became the National Champions for the first time in the history (Photo: VTB League)

title: Zenit upset CSKA in Moscow to claim the title
description: CSKA - Zenit 75-81 Zenit have been crowned VTB League champions tonight. They upset CSKA in Moscow to claim the trophy. CSKA was trailing by 2 points at halftime but managed to get 6-point lead after three quarters before a 25-13 charge of Zenit, which allowed them to win the game. They made 23-of-25 free shots (92.0 percent) during the game. It was a great evening for American power forward Jordan Mickey (203-1994, college: LSU) who led his team to a victory scoring 19 points and 9 rebounds. His fellow American import Jordan Loyd (193-1993, college: Indianapolis) helped adding 17 points, 6 rebounds and 6 assists. At the losing side Serbian center Nikola Milutinov (213-1994, agency: Octagon Europe) responded with a double-double by scoring 16 points and 17 rebounds and American point guard Casper Ware (178-1990, college: LBSU) scored 17 points and 6 assists. Both teams had four players…

description: CSKA - Unics 89-81 CSKA claimed VTB League title. They beat Unics in Game 3 in Moscow to complete the sweep of the Finals. Unics trailed by 11 points after 3 quarters before a 15-12 run in the last quarter cut the deficit to 81-89 at the end of the game. It was a great evening for Georgian forward Tornike Shengelia (206-91, agency: Wasserman) who led his team to a victory scoring 19 points and 7 rebounds. American Will Clyburn (201-90, college: Iowa St.) helped adding 18 points and 5 assists, while Daniel Hackett (193-G-87, college: USC) had 17 points and was named the MVP. The best for the losing side was American forward John Brown III (203-92, college: High Point) with a double-double by scoring 25 points and 11 rebounds and the other American import guard Jamar Smith (191-87, college: S.Indiana, agency: Inception Sports) scored 17 points. title: CSKA clinch VTB title
description: Khimki - CSKA 62-80 (0-3) The game without a history. CSKA led from the first minutes and controlled entire game increasing their lead in each quarter. It was a great evening for American guard Cory Higgins (196-89, college: Colorado) who led his team to a victory scoring 23 points. Forward Nikita Kurbanov (202-86) helped adding 12 points, 6 rebounds and 5 assists. The best for the losing side was guard Viacheslav Zaytsev (190-89, agency: Alti Sport) with 22 points and 5 rebounds and American center Malcolm Thomas (206-88, college: San Diego St.) scored 8 points and 7 rebounds. Both coaches used bench players which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games.

title: CSKA beat Khimki to repeat as champions
description: FINAL CSKA - Khimki 95-84 CSKA defended their VTB League title. They outgunned Khimki in the title game in Moscow tonight to claim the seventh straight League trophy. The game was mostly controlled by CSKA. Khimki managed to win third quarter 28-25. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. They made 25-of-30 free shots (83.3 percent) during the game. CSKA looked well-organized offensively handing out 24 assists. 24 personal fouls committed by Khimki helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. French Nando De-Colo (196-87) fired 18 points and 7 assists (made all of his ten free throws !!!) for the winners. American swingman Cory Higgins (196-89, college: Colorado) chipped in 20 points and 4 steals. Guard Alexey Shved (198-88, agency: Alti Sport) produced 21 points and 9 assists and American forward Malcolm Thomas (206-88, college: San Diego St.)…

title: CSKA sweep Khimki to repeat as champions
description: Khimki - CSKA 72:95 CSKA conquered the sixth straight VTB League title. They eased past Khimki on the road to complete the sweep of the championship series. Nando De Colo (196-SG-87) scored 20 points to pace the champions. CSKA silenced the hosts in the first term. The Moscow side triggered a massive 34:12 run in the opening ten minutes to clear off. The teams traded baskets throughout the second frame. CSKA ensured a comfortable 56:34 halftime lead. The situation did not improve for the home side in the third term. CSKA boosted the margin at 27-point mark heading into the fourth stanza. Khimki slowed their opponents in the final period but could not avoid the defeat. Cory Higgins (195-G-89, college: Colorado) netted 18 points, while Aaron Jackson (190-G-86, college: Duquesne) added 14 points for the winners. Alexey Shved (198-G-88, agency: Alti Sport) replied with 17 points for Khimki.…

title: CSKA edge Unics in Kazan to claim the title
description: Unics - CSKA 74-81 CSKA fired past Unics in Kazan to celebrate VTB League title. The victory marked the sixth VTB League triumph for the Moscow powerhouse. Unics Kazan trailed by 13 points after 3 quarters. However an incredible performance from Arturas Milaknis helped Unics get back into the game. The Lithuanian sharpshooter sank 7 three-pointers after the big break to keep Unics hopeful. But CSKA executed calmly in the dying minutes and iced the winning outcome. CSKA made 17-of-21 free shots (81.0 percent) during the game. Worth to mention a great performance of French Nando De Colo (196-87) who helped to win the game recording 16 points and 5 assists. Serbian point guard Milos Teodosic (195-87) contributed with 11 points for the winners. Lithuanian guard Arturas Milaknis (195-86) replied with 23 points and Anton Ponkrashov (200-86, agency: BeoBasket) added 11 points and 8 assists in…

CSKA led from the first minutes and controlled entire game increasing their lead in each quarter. They shot 63.3 percent from the field and made 26-of-30 free shots (86.7 percent) during the game, while Khimky only scored seven points from the stripe. They outrebounded Khimky 36-20 including a 30-11 advantage in defensive rebounds. It was a great shooting night for CSKA especially from behind the arc, where they had solid 61.1 percentage. They looked well-organized offensively handing out 26 assists. Great defensive blocking was one of the keys in this match when CSKA made 7 blocks. 27 personal fouls committed by Khimky helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. description: CSKA - N.Novgorod 82-66 CSKA defended their VTB League title. They outgunned visiting Nizhny Novgorod in Moscow to sweep the title series. The victory marked the third consecutive VTB League title for the Moscow powerhouse. CSKA Moscow led from the first minutes and controlled entire game increasing their lead in each quarter. They made 19-of-25 free shots (76.0 percent) during the game. CSKA Moscow looked well-organized offensively handing out 24 assists. Great defensive blocking was one of the keys in this match when CSKA Moscow made 7 blocks. 24 personal fouls committed by BC Nizhny Novgorod helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. The best player for the winners was Serbian point guard Milos Teodosic (195-87) who scored 16 points and 6 assists. Forward Viktor Khryapa (203-82) chipped in 5 points, 10 rebounds and 8 assists. title: CSKA defend VTB League title
description: Lokomotiv - CSKA 54:59 CSKA defend VTB League title as they won the fourth game against Lokomotiv. CSKA posted a 59:54 defensive win and sealed the trophy of the League again. It was another thriller in the court. The guests trailed by 6 points at the halftime before their 32-21 charge in the second half, which allowed them to win the game. Sokolov and Savrasenko were sent off the court because of the fight in the third period. CSKA Moscow dominated on the defensive end, holding Lokomotiv to just 7 points in fourth quarter. American swingman Sonny Weems (198-G/F-86, college: Arkansas) fired 24 points for the winners. Andrey Vorontsevich (207-C-87) chipped in 9 points and 9 rebounds. American-Greek point guard Nick Calathes (198-PG-89, college: Florida) produced 11 points, 6 rebounds and 7 assists and Derrick Brown (203-F-87, college: Xavier) added 16 points and 5 rebounds respectively…

description: Final: Unics - CSKA 62-74 CSKA celebrated the second VTB League title in their history. They overcame Unics in the Final tonight in Vilnius to repeat the success of 2009/10 season. Darjus Lavrinovic scored 15 points to pace the effort. Andrei Kirilenko (205-F-81) was named the MVP of Final Four. CSKA opened the game with eight points in a row. Teodosic made it 11:1 less than two minutes into the game. The Moscow team maintained the lead posting a 22:15 advantage after ten minutes. Nathan Jawai (208-F/C-86, college: Midland CC) brought Unics back to life in the second quarter. The Kazan team narrowed the margin to just a single point 33:34. CSKA however remained in front as they posted a 40:37 halftime advantage. CSKA went on an 8:0 run at the start of the second half to open an 11-point lead. title: Khimky are new VTB League champions
description: Final: Khimky - CSKA 66-64 Khimky are crowned new VTB League champions. They overcame CSKA in the dramatic Final in Kazan tonight. Kresimir Loncar (210-F-83, agency: Alti Sport) stepped up with 18 points to lead the winners. Travis Hansen and Thomas Kelati (195-G/F-82, agency: Beo Basket, college: Washington St.) knocked down five free throws in the dying seconds of the game to seal the victory for Khimky. Thomas Kelati helped Khimky to a 9:2 start. CSKA struggled offensively in the opening frame. They scored just six points to face an 11-point deficit at the first intermission. Kresimir Loncar stretched the margin to 13 points early in the second term. But CSKA went on a 17:2 to steal the lead.
